map.不可压缩流体质量守恒。: Mass conservation for an incompressible fluid.
map.连续性方程：不可压缩流体 A₁·v₁ = A₂·v₂，即流量 Q 恒等不变；流速: Continuity equation: for an incompressible fluid A₁·v₁ = A₂·v₂, so the discharge Q stays constant; velocity is inversely proportional to the cross-sectional area, so a narrower section means a higher velocity; from discharge and area the mean velocity is v = Q ÷ A, used in pipe and open channel design.
map.截面减小则流速增大。: A smaller cross-section means a higher velocity.
map.算变截面流速: Compute the velocity across a changing section
map.A1*v1 = A2*v2（不可压）。例：管 A1=0.01 m2、v1=1 m: A1*v1 = A2*v2 for incompressible flow. Example: a pipe with A1=0.01 m² and v1=1 m/s narrowing to A2=0.005 m² gives v2=2 m/s.
map.用 rho*A*v=常数，密度也参与变化。: Use rho*A*v = constant, since the density changes as well.
map.本质？: What is the essence of it?
map.稳态质量守恒：流入=流出。: Steady-state mass conservation: what flows in equals what flows out.
